 Print RRB Paramedical exam 2026: Hall tickets released for 590 vacancies, check details before examination day RRB Paramedical admit card 2026 : The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 for candidates appearing in the Computer-Based Test (CBT) under Centralised Employment Notification (CEN) 05/2026. The hall ticket download facility is available through the candidate login portal at rrb.digialm.com. Candidates can access their admit cards using their registration number and date of birth or password. The RRB Paramedical examination is scheduled for November 23 and 25, 2026, to fill 590 vacancies across nine paramedical categories. Admit cards are being released approximately four days before the respective examination dates. Candidates must download and print their hall tickets before reporting to their allotted examination centres. RRB Paramedical admit card 2026: Important details The recruitment examination covers posts including Nursing Superintendent, Pharmacist, Health and Malaria Inspector, Lab Assistant, Radiographer, ECG Technician, Dialysis Technician, Optometrist, and Audiologist and Speech Therapist.  Candidates appearing on both examination dates can check the login portal for their respective hall tickets. How to download RRB Paramedical hall ticket
 Step 1: Candidates can follow these steps to download their admit cards: Step 2: Visit the official RRB website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in. Step 3: Open the CEN 05/2026 Paramedical admit card link. Step 4: Access the candidate login page at rrb.digialm.com. Step 5: Enter the registration number and date of birth or password. Step 6: Complete the CAPTCHA verification, if required. Step 7: Submit the details to access the hall ticket. Step 8: Download the admit card and take a printout. • Direct link to check and download the RRB CEN 05/2026 hall ticket Details to check on the admit card The hall ticket contains the candidate's name, roll number, registration number, photograph, signature, examination date, shift timing, reporting time and examination centre address. Candidates should verify these details carefully and contact their respective RRB in case of discrepancies. Candidates must carry a printed admit card and an original valid identity document to the examination centre. The city intimation slip is not a substitute for the admit card.
